evidence: Traupman 52: melodrāma vīsere, go to see an opera
terms.comment: Traupman’s word, Greek μελόδραμα, a play with song; his melodrāmatium is an operetta or a musical (see musical). In English a melodrama is something else.
Morgan–Owens, after Egger; drāma itself is late (Ausonius, Lewis & Short).

terms.gloss: an opera house, a concert hall
evidence: M-O s.v. concert hall: opera house
terms.comment: The Greek odeon, a roofed building for music.

phrases.english: to go and see an opera

sources: Lewis & Short: drama · Lewis & Short: odeum
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. works: opera; concert hall: opera house. John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 52, checked against the searchable text of the book.
